title: A Formal Group Perspective on the Riemann Zeta Function
summary: We develop a formal group--theoretic framework for the Riemann zeta function by treating its Euler product as an element of the multiplicative formal group $\widehat{\mathbb{G}}_m$ and its logarithm as the associated formal group logarithm. This provides a purely algebraic linearization of the multiplicative prime-wise structure of the Euler product. Starting from a finite cutoff model, we introduce a formal completion via evenization and a natural normalization procedure.
